technical_summary: Workload mix: 60% low-latency chat (avg request 45 tokens), 25% personalization (short reranking, 30-80 tokens), 15% bulk embedding indexing (batch). Baseline steady-state QPS target: 120 QPS across all routes. Peak (holiday) planning: target sustained 600 QPS for 6 hours/day for 10 days. Token/sec baseline (steady): ~5,400 tokens/sec (120 QPS * 45 tokens avg). Peak token/sec target: ~27,000 tokens/sec. Latency goals: p95 < 150ms for chat small-turns, p99 < 300ms. Throughput guarantee ask: 24/7 sustained throughput SLA with defined burst headroom (2x sustained for 15 minutes) and automatic fallback to smaller model variants on capacity contention.
sizing_considerations: Customer preference: H100 class or equivalent for dense transformer inference. Preliminary internal ask: estimate 6-8 GPUs for steady-state, 24 GPUs to cover holiday sustained peak with controlled batching. Wants explicit reserve vs burst split and clear rules for scaling. Cache strategy: prefix KV cache for recurrent sessions expected to reduce effective token/sec by ~18% after warm-up. SE note: bench harness required with 5k concurrent sessions to validate p95 at target loads.
sla_negotiation_points:
- Target SLA: 99.9% uptime for dedicated pool.
- Latency SLOs tied to route level (chat, rerank) with measurement windows (30d rolling).
- Credits: 5% monthly credit for breach of uptime, escalation ladder for repeated misses.
- Failure modes: automated fallback to hosted-compatible smaller model, and cross-region failover in case of zone outage.
- Legal has asked for defined MTTR (4 hours for major incidents) and root cause reports within 72 hours.
workshop_agenda: 1) 15m — goals + constraints recap; 2) 30m — review production traces (p50/p95/p99 + token histograms); 3) 30m — throughput modelling (QPS -> token/sec -> GPU mapping); 4) 25m — sizing options (steady vs peak, reserve vs burst), cost delta; 5) 20m — next steps + open items (security checklist, procurement timeline)
